task.title: Filter finite recurrences by lifecycle status through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/981 to expose exact recurrence lifecycle-status filtering as deterministic read-only JSON.
acceptance_criteria: Accept only exact lowercase active or cancelled status before storage access.
Emit matching complete recurrence definitions in deterministic exact-ID order.
Open only existing storage read-only and fail without partial stdout on malformed history.

attempts.diagnostic: The CLI rejected recurrence status inspection because the status subcommand did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added focused CLI tests for mixed statuses, ordering, empty results, escaping, validation, missing storage, and malformed histories.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded adapter.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented strict status parsing, read-only store delegation, and deterministic inventory JSON while reusing the complete recurrence representation.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 981 in crates/vela-dev/src/lib.rs with focused tests, ADR-0090, and scheduler documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found no blocking issues; a rate-limited false green was excluded until genuine CodeRabbit run 4df8e49e completed on the exact head with no actionable comments and zero unresolved threads.
attempts.patch: Preserved the verified head through cooldown and armed merge only after exact-head CI and review readiness were confirmed.

outcome.summary: Issue 981 delivered deterministic recurrence status JSON without adding mutation or execution authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 982 exact head 5522caf8d37382cf70fadd1a83e279a52ad5d0ab

lessons: CLI status parsing should precede storage access and preserve the kernel as lifecycle-validation authority.
Complete recurrence serialization can be shared across unfiltered and status-filtered inventory commands.
The adapter grants no mutation, clock, worker, dispatch, retry, permission, or execution authority.
